context: Final-quarter PR review meeting between boss and manager
purpose: Teach: バブル/借金/商業/極端/過剰/比率/保守/広報

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の決算だが、借金の総額が想定より膨らんでいるな。
lines.en: Regarding this quarter's results, our total debt has swelled more than expected.
lines.style: Stern senior executive tone, controlled disappointment, slow measured delivery

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、自己資本比率が業界平均を下回ってしまっております。
lines.en: Yes, our equity ratio has fallen below the industry average.
lines.style: Formal middle-manager reporting bad news to superior, careful keigo

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 商業施設への投資が過剰だったんじゃないか。
lines.en: Wasn't our investment in commercial facilities excessive?
lines.style: Pointed accusation softened by rhetorical phrasing, business-meeting register

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。バブル期のような強気な計画を引きずっておりました。
lines.en: You are quite right. We were dragging along bullish plans reminiscent of the bubble era.
lines.style: Apologetic acknowledgment, formal self-reflection, humble tone toward boss

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来期は極端な拡大路線はやめて、もっと保守的な経営に切り替えてくれ。
lines.en: Next quarter, drop the extreme expansion strategy and switch to more conservative management.
lines.style: Direct command from boss, firm but not angry, decisive instruction

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知いたしました。広報部にも数字の出し方を慎重に調整させます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the PR department carefully adjust how we present the numbers.
lines.style: Compliant manager confirming directives, professional and measured pace

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼んだぞ。株主が極端な反応をしないよう、言葉選びには気をつけろ。
lines.en: I'm counting on you. Choose your words carefully so shareholders don't overreact.
lines.style: Trusting yet warning tone, gruff masculine boss speech, slightly lowered voice
